en.title: Engineered {{Full OLX Marketplace Web Platform}}!
en.text: Engineered a comprehensive classifieds marketplace web platform inspired by OLX. Built from scratch using modern HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, and Bootstrap 5, featuring authentic brand styling, multi-category routing (Motors, Property, Electronics), and seamless user interactions.
list: Custom navigation bar with location selection, search filters, and category toggles
Dynamic ad listing grids, product detail previews, and interactive user action buttons
Fully mobile-responsive layout structured according to modern UI/UX design standards

en.title: Completed {{Full-Featured Clinic Management System}}!
en.text: Architected and deployed a web-based healthcare management system tailored for clinic operations, doctor scheduling, and patient administration. Built to streamline operational workflows and improve medical record management.
list: Real-time appointment booking portal with dynamic status tracking (Pending, Confirmed, Completed)
Doctor shift allocation, patient medical history logs, and prescription record management
Clean dashboard interface built with responsive data tables and secure form validation

en.title: Deployed {{NOMAN BURGER Fast-Food Platform}}!
en.text: Successfully engineered, styled, and deployed a complete web application for 'NOMAN BURGER, Fastfood & Bar B.Q'. The platform delivers a fast, interactive food ordering experience with real-time cart calculations and backend menu management.
list: Categorized food menu with dynamic item filtering, custom deals, and price calculations
Interactive order cart with live quantity modifications and checkout validation
Admin management panel to handle live orders and dynamic product inventory updates

en.title: Built Helplytics AI at {{SMIT Grand Coding Night 2026}}!
en.text: Participated in the high-intensity overnight SMIT Grand Coding Night 2026 hackathon and collaborated with team members to build 'Helplytics AI' — a community support network platform.
list: Developed interactive frontend components using React.js and Tailwind CSS under strict time constraints
Implemented statistics metric cards, dynamic feature highlights, and seamless product demo routing

en.title: Developed {{TaskNova Task & User Management App}}!
en.text: Engineered 'TaskNova', a production-ready task management dashboard featuring secure user authentication modules, multi-role access controls, and real-time database syncing.
list: Integrated Firebase Authentication with login, registration, and automated password reset workflows
Configured Firestore database structure with strict security rules for user and admin data protection
Built user task tracking boards and admin oversight panels with dynamic updates
